note: reel_check (reel-check.md not released). Story type: INTERVIEW (single outlet), label تقرير. Mohammad: keep news ongoing (4 Nov 16:15 Dubai). Hook: ARC Raiders' CEO says adding PvE would be easy. Why now: Insider Gaming 4 Nov quoting Patrick Soderlund (CEO) and Aleksander Grondal (executive producer) in a recent interview with The Game Business; no interview date. Quotes: 'we need to listen and cater for both camps', 'we could just frankly add PvE. It is not a difficult thing for us to do'. Players here: PvE test after the Frozen Trail update drew 30 million PvE matches in a week, about half of test-week matches (per Insider Gaming). Payoff: no official plan or date; Embark has not confirmed. Footage route: Steam app 1808500 official trailer, a stretch from 20 s, stand-in credit; primary interview (The Game Business) not read. picture: ARC Raiders Steam trailer 20 to 41.6 s.
